evidence: All tests pass: `cargo test -p tank_core -p tank_data -p tank_scenarios` — 0 failures across all crates including chemistry (19 tests), save_load (13), shrimp, substrate/filter, water_change_mass_balance, determinism, materialization, and startup_overrides.
`cargo clippy -p tank_core -p tank_data -p tank_scenarios --all-targets -- -D warnings` produces zero warnings.
`cargo fmt --all --check` produces no output — formatting is clean.
Old pH shortcut (`6.3 + log10(alk) - log10(DIC)`) is completely absent; all pH computation routes through `solve_carbonate_equilibrium()` (chemistry.rs:221-300).
Solver uses temperature-corrected pKa1 via Harned & Davis (1943) at chemistry.rs:14-17; PKA2 is fixed at 10.33 with documented rationale (line 19-22).
Solver is a deterministic O(1) closed-form quadratic in [H+] with no iteration (chemistry.rs:248-286). `solver_deterministic` test confirms identical outputs for identical inputs.

All three fallback paths (`fallback_acid_dominated`, `fallback_high_buffer`, `fallback_outside_quadratic_envelope`) now reproject species at the solved/clamped pH via `carbonate_species_for_ph()` (chemistry.rs:115-116, 143-144, dispatched at 189-207).
All fallback paths emit structured `tracing::debug!` diagnostics via `emit_carbonate_fallback_diagnostic()` (chemistry.rs:86-104). `tracing = "0.1"` confirmed in Cargo.toml.

Zero-DIC with alkalinity now returns pH 8.5 (CARBONATE_PH_MAX) instead of neutral pH 7.0, making the zero-DIC branch limit-consistent with the alkaline ceiling (chemistry.rs:162-180). Test `solver_edge_case_zero_dic` at line 251 confirms `eq.ph == 8.5`.
Zero-DIC with zero-alkalinity still returns NEUTRAL_FALLBACK (pH 7.0), which is the physically correct deionized water result (chemistry.rs:163-164, test at line 260).
V2→V3 migration intentionally excludes `bicarbonate_mg_total` from dissolved_fields rescaling with explicit comment explaining it is solver-derived (save.rs:282-284).

`normalize_loaded_carbonate_state()` (save.rs:342-351) unconditionally re-solves from canonical DIC/alkalinity/temperature on load, repairing stale caches. `reconcile_stability_tracker()` (save.rs:353-368) updates `prev_ph` to avoid false instability spikes.

Source-water validation unified: both `SourceWaterPreset::validate()` in tank_data (presets.rs) and `SourceWaterProfile::validate()` in tank_core (source_water.rs:66-76) call `validate_source_water_carbonate_profile()` from chemistry.rs:314-330, which runs the same `solve_carbonate_equilibrium` solver.
TankSnapshot exposes `ph` (line 29), `co2_aq_mmol_per_l` (line 22), and `dissolved_inorganic_carbon_mg_l` (line 21), all derived via the solver.
48-point parameter sweep (`solver_species_conservation_sweep`) validates species conservation and pH bounds across DIC=[2,10,20,40] × Alk=[0.25,1.0,1.5,3.0] × T=[15,25,35].
Edge cases tested: zero volume, zero DIC, zero alkalinity, extreme high buffer, and temperature response directionality — all confirmed no NaN/Inf.
Integration tests confirm: nitrification lowers alkalinity and pH, photosynthesis raises pH without changing alkalinity, DIC changes don't shift alkalinity, light-driven DIC changes drift pH.

Shipped presets produce differentiated pH: `shipped_source_water_presets_have_distinct_carbonate_ph` (presets.rs) and `shipped_source_water_profiles_materialize_distinct_initial_ph` (tank_scenarios) verify ordering soft < moderate < hard with spread >= 0.3 pH units.

Runtime rejection test `invalid_resolved_profile_out_of_calibrated_carbonate_range_returns_error` (water_change_mass_balance.rs) confirms SimError::InvalidSourceProfile for out-of-range carbonate chemistry.
`resolve_carbonate_state()` (chemistry.rs:337-346) is called after all DIC/alkalinity mutations — in water_change, rescale, save-load normalization, and from_source_profile constructors.
findings_or_gaps: Minor: `fallback_zero_dic` does not emit a tracing diagnostic on the NEUTRAL_FALLBACK path (chemistry.rs:163-164, when both DIC and alk are negligible). This is defensible since pure-water equilibrium is not an edge case requiring operator attention, but it is a gap relative to the contract's blanket 'emit a structured diagnostic' requirement. Severity: cosmetic.

Ka2 is fixed at 10.33 without temperature correction. Documented as acceptable for the freshwater pH 5.5-8.5 regime where CO3-- is a minor fraction, but should be revisited if the solver is extended to marine or high-pH scenarios.
The v3→v4 migration is a no-op relying on serde defaults. Future field additions requiring non-default initialization should not blindly follow this pattern.

Legacy saves with custom out-of-range source-water catalog entries will still deserialize, but water-change actions against those profiles will now fail at runtime with InvalidSourceProfile — the validation contract shift is correct but could surprise users with old custom profiles.
